subject: [PATCH v3 1/4] net/core: optimize skb allocation in high-throughput drivers
body:
From: Linus W <developer@kernel.org>
To: netdev@vger.kernel.org

This patch reduces cache-line bouncing during skb allocation by prefetching the ring buffer descriptor earlier in the napi_poll loop.

Tested with ixgbe on 10GbE interface with 1500 byte MTU.
Performance results showed a 4.2% increase in packets per second.

Signed-off-by: Linus W <developer@kernel.org>
Acked-by: Dave M <davem@davemloft.net>
